name: Comte de Provence
source:
"...Duke Barry, hunting is something to be very careful about. You don't want to be mistaken for an animal and shot."

Born in France.
Hobby: Things That Stand Out
Likes: His Own Allies
Dislikes: Louis XVI & Marie Antoinette

The one in control of the region of Provence.
A prideful and jealous person, he considers anything that happens to be his older brother Louis XVI's (Duke Barry) fault.
He isn't satisfied that the unmotivated Louis would make a good king just because he's a year older.
He's always disagreeable and prejudiced against Louis, but he always gets left out of things and is made fun of by his younger brother the Count of Artois.
